core_meaning.primary_meaning: Eliyas is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “An. The source record”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Eliyas corresponds to the Hebrew form إلياس (Hebrew אֵלִיָּהוּ). Its core sense is god is my oath. Ilyās, the Arabic form of Elijah, a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'God is my oath' is an approximation.
